title: Odyssey successfully hotfires for the lander challenge
summary: ERPL's HTPB/nitrous oxide hybrid completed a successful hot fire as part of the team's lander challenge entry. The campaign established the feed, data acquisition, and operating foundation used by later liquid engines.

title: Triton completes two successful hot fires
summary: A first-year team moved a LOX/ethanol engine from training to two successful tests at Cecil Spaceport in ten months.

title: MOE successfully reaches full-scale hot fire
summary: The 2,250 lbf-class MOE engine successfully ignited and ran through roughly half of the planned burn before a nozzle shear ended the test. The campaign exercised the integrated system and identified the next hardware changes.

title: A composite chamber test finds the next limit
summary: A full-scale composite chamber attempt destroyed the engine and damaged Draco. The result produced a clear integration lesson and an immediate rebuild plan.

title: Five freshmen rebuild Draco in weeks
summary: First-year members redesigned the LOX and pressurant systems, tank restraints, relief sizing, and thrust structure, returning the stand to operation within weeks.

title: The composite chamber returns to hot fire
summary: After rebuilding Draco, the team paired a composite chamber with Triton's smaller injector and successfully hotfired it, validating the chamber concept at reduced scale.
